summary: The @gyomu/ai-compiler package provides a structured framework for automating code analysis and documentation tasks using AI models. It defines formal schemas and execution pipelines to transform source code metadata into actionable documentation plans, file summaries, and project-level insights. By standardizing input contexts and output plans, the package ensures deterministic, auditable transformations for TypeScript codebases.
responsibilities: Define standardized schemas for representing source code structure and documentation states.
Manage the execution logic for AI-assisted documentation and summarization pipelines.
Provide deterministic mechanisms for determining complexity and update modes for code transformations.
Facilitate the integration of AI models into automated code maintenance workflows.
Ensure auditability of AI-generated content through structured merge actions and reasoning traces.

capabilities.name: JSDoc Automation
capabilities.description: Orchestrates the analysis and automated updating of JSDoc comments based on symbol complexity and structural metadata.

capabilities.name: Codebase Summarization
capabilities.description: Generates concise conceptual summaries for files, directories, and entire packages to improve developer navigation and documentation.

capabilities.name: Pipeline Orchestration
capabilities.description: Provides a consistent execution framework for running various AI-driven code analysis tasks with configurable context and strategies.

capabilities.name: Content Translation
capabilities.description: Exposes infrastructure for translating technical documentation and summaries using configured AI model routes.

capabilities.name: Readme Generation
capabilities.description: Supports the programmatic construction of documentation sections within README files using structured AI-driven templates.

designDecisions: Utilizes a route-based identification system to decouple AI task definitions from specific model implementation details.
Employs a strategy-based approach for handling task complexity, allowing for configurable precision in code analysis.
Enforces a schema-first architecture where every AI operation relies on typed input and output structures to ensure reliability.
Separates execution logic from data context, enabling independent testing of the pipeline orchestrators and the underlying data models.
usageGuidance: Use the provided context types to build inputs for pipelines rather than passing raw source code data.
Implement or extend the existing complexity strategy when adding new documentation tasks to ensure appropriate AI resource allocation.
Leverage the standardized merge actions to maintain existing code documentation styles when applying AI updates.
Always rely on the executor interfaces to trigger operations, ensuring that metadata and reasoning traces are correctly handled for auditability.
